title: Freedom
supportedClaims: The highest return money can buy is control over your time and attention.
Autonomy changes daily life more deeply than status purchases because it lowers coercion in work, relationships, and decision-making.
The practical implication is to measure wealth not only by assets but by how much choice those assets create in ordinary life.
caution: Freedom is easily sold away when spending habits rise faster than judgment and force you to keep playing someone else's game.
